look_here_first: Narrow-leaved purple ironweed of dry rocky sites: linear leaves with densely woolly lower surfaces, usually glabrate upper surfaces, and strongly revolute margins.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: purple discoid heads in corymbiform arrays

lookalikes.differences: Much narrower-leaved than V. baldwinii; watch for intermediate V. × guadalupensis.
